convert_votenet_checkpoint: convert a VoteNet checkpoint from before MMDet3D v0.6.0 to the latest version format
run_checkpoint_conversion: run the VoteNet checkpoint conversion tool with an input checkpoint file and output path
parse_votenet_config: parse and update a VoteNet model config string to be compatible with the latest MMDet3D version
rename_checkpoint_keys: rename and restructure VoteNet checkpoint state dict keys to match the new model architecture
extract_checkpoint_weights: extract and reorganize classification and regression weights from a VoteNet checkpoint for the new conv_out layer
